title: 🙌🏼 THIS APP IS A LIFE CHANGER!! 🙌🏼
body: I have used Goblin Tools online for maybe a year now and I am beyond excited to see the app available! I used to struggle with sequencing tasks and procrastination, but now I just type in what I need to do into Magic To-Do and Goblin tools breaks the task down into achievable and sensible steps. I then carry out the tasks quickly with focus. And this is only one part of the app. There is also options to enhance communication and understanding, time management, meal inspiration (just type in what food you have on hand and it will give you a meal suggestion), it can organise tasks from your brain dump, it can suggest how to reword a message in a myriad of ways (‘less snarky’ is a good one for diplomacy). I honestly would have paid a lot more to own this app. It is my life saver. Thank you Goblin Tools Team! You have made me feel like I am completely winning at being a grown up.

title: Crying happy tears
body:
Considering the fact that I have adhd, low-spectrum autism, clinical anxiety and depression among many others, makes staying on task, being consistent and starting things that I don't want to difficult. So finding a routine and something that breaks things down for me, is lifesaving. The $2 I spent were worth it. 
You can choose how much of a task is broken down, estimate a time of how long it may take do the task and takes the pressure of trying to plan out assignments or exams or any tasks really, off. 

Within this app, you can also find different sorts of systems to better manage writing, child-brain moments, etc.
They have a judge thing where you can write something and it will tell you how it's comes across. This app has made my Nerodivergent brain feel much less complicated than ever.

I highly recommend spending the $2 if you experience anything related to preparation, organisation, commitment, etc. Issues.

author: Myekal

title: Legitimately helpful
body: The app developers clearly know their demographic because the specificity of the ‘breaking down’ feature demonstrates they understand the difficulties around writing lists. For someone with ADHD and OCD it makes writing lists a breeze. I can simply use the highest spiciness level and remove tasks that don’t apply to my situation. The estimation time on task completion is a little off, with  some tasks like dishes and laundry being 5h + estimation though. The judge and formaliser options are also legitimately helpful. They give insightful answers that break down language use and how it can be interpreted which is so useful for someone who struggles to interpret social cues and tone from messages. The level of understanding that this app/website provides makes it feels like you’ve asked a human to help you, rather than a robot. I 100% recommend giving it a try. The website is perfectly fine to use on a regular basis, but I chose to support the work the developers have put in and buy the app. It runs a little smoother on the app anyways 🙂.

title: Life changing
body:
I am in tears writing this because this app is just so perfectly what I need and it makes me feel so understood. 
It is absolutely life-changing because it will do the things that my brain cannot. 
Need to do the dishes but don’t know where to start? This app will break it down into small steps for you.
Need to say something but don’t want to just yell your feelings at someone? This app will help you put it into words. 
Need someone to check that your email is worded professionally and politely? This app will check it for you. 
Need to do a bunch of jobs but know that you will underestimate how long they will take? This app will give you a realistic estimate. 
Seriously, if you’re neurospicy, get this app right now.
